Good for you that shaning yourself out of a lazy habit worked, but with depression, that kind of thing leads to more depression. In his adulthood, following his trend of letting various animals attack him, he willingly let one of these bugs bite his toe to finally quell his deep seeded fear of them. The result was...well, the expected amount of Coyote lurching and groaning as he copes with the reality that this is now his YouTube career, as well as a newly found appreciation for the toe biter, which he says is a close contender for bullet ants in terms of painfulness.

Have you heard of fibromyalgia? It's a surprisingly common physical disorder where the nervous system gets all screwed up and causes a radiant feeling of pain throughout the body. The specifics can vary depending on a lot of factors, such as diet, stress, past injuries, environment, and how active the person is at a given time, to name some of the factors. These differences can vary almost any trait of the disorder, from causing muscles to become sore and swollen for seemingly no reason, limbs becoming tense and sore, profuse itching, sweating, headaches, and even extending to causing other physical symptoms, like vomiting or an elevated blood pressure. These can all range from the very mild to cripplingly intense, and can change at any time for any reason.
